This [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''attendant''' lived in the [[Outbound Flight Colony]] in [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], she was assigned to watch after the colony's [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children while they were quarantined due to [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|fears]] that they could be trained as Jedi. She worked alongside an [[Unidentified attendant (older)|older woman]]. She briefly met [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Chak Fel]], who found the prison while exploring the colony, and initially mistook him for [[Perry]], a [[Peacekeeper (Outbound Flight Colony)|Peacekeeper]] assigned to the Quarantine zone.
